description: Create an audio post. The audio is uploaded first through the blob-upload flow and referenced here as an embed; this procedure writes the record, not the bytes.

main.description: Writes a dev.antiphony.audio.post authored by the acting actor. Tenancy and authorship are stamped server-side from the credential and the asserted actor — supplying them in the body has no effect. `reply` presence makes the post a reply; its absence makes it a prompt.

text.description: USER-authored text. May be empty when an audio embed is present, but a post with neither text nor audio is rejected.

title.description: Optional headline. Prompts only — supplying one alongside `reply` is rejected.

embed.description: The audio attachment, referencing an already-uploaded blob.

reply.description: StrongRef root + parent. Present ⇒ this is a reply. Each `cid` must be the stored record's: `parent` the post answered, `root` its thread's prompt.

langs.description: BCP-47 language tags for the text.

processing.description: Opt-in audio processing for this post's audio. Runs asynchronously; the post is created either way.

space.description: Place the post in one of the tenant's spaces; the returned `uri` is then a space URI, whose author segment is the tenant's DID (never the actor's), and its audio plays only through signed URLs. The audio must have been uploaded into the same space. A reply to a post in a space inherits that space and must not name another; a reply to a flat post may name one.

uri.description: at:// URI of the created post.

cid.description: Content CID of the created record. Together with `uri` this is a StrongRef, directly usable as the `reply` target of a subsequent post.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The payload failed validation — an empty post, a reply carrying a title, a reply naming a space other than its parent's, a `reply.root` that is not the thread's root, or audio stored somewhere other than the post's space.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The named space does not exist for this tenant, or a reply's parent was not found.

errors.name: ReplyCidMismatch
errors.description: A reply's `reply.parent.cid` or `reply.root.cid` is not the CID of the stored record it names.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: An earlier request with the same idempotency key is still in flight. Retry after it settles.
